<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Organisation" processRef="sales-process" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="sales-process" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="sales-lanes">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inquiry-start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inquire</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>approve-quote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>quote-declined</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="sales-staff" name="Sales staff or customer support">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>collect-information</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>address-concerns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>customer-interested</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>guide-selection</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inquiry-closed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="sales-rep" name="Sales representative">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>provide-quote</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>quote-approved</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>place-order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>record-order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>confirm-order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>order-confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="inquiry-start" name="Potential customer inquires" />
    <bpmn:task id="inquire" name="Inquire about a product or service" />
    <bpmn:task id="collect-information" name="Collect relevant information" />
    <bpmn:task id="address-concerns" name="Address concerns or questions" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="customer-interested" name="Customer interested?" />
    <bpmn:task id="guide-selection" name="Guide the customer through selecting the product or service" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="inquiry-closed" name="Inquiry closed, customer not interested" />
    <bpmn:task id="provide-quote" name="Provide a quote" />
    <bpmn:task id="approve-quote" name="Approve the quote" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="quote-approved" name="Quote approved?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="quote-declined" name="Quote declined" />
    <bpmn:task id="place-order" name="Place the order" />
    <bpmn:task id="record-order" name="Record the order in the system" />
    <bpmn:task id="confirm-order" name="Confirm the order to the customer" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="order-confirmed" name="Order placed and confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="inquiry-start" targetRef="inquire" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="inquire" targetRef="collect-information" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="collect-information" targetRef="address-concerns" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="address-concerns" targetRef="customer-interested" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" name="yes" sourceRef="customer-interested" targetRef="guide-selection" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" name="no" sourceRef="customer-interested" targetRef="inquiry-closed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="guide-selection" targetRef="provide-quote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" sourceRef="provide-quote" targetRef="approve-quote" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="approve-quote" targetRef="quote-approved" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" name="yes" sourceRef="quote-approved" targetRef="place-order" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" name="no" sourceRef="quote-approved" targetRef="quote-declined" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="place-order" targetRef="record-order" />

  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
